filters.description: Limits the quarantine to builds on matching branches and of matching Workflows or Pipelines. Values may contain `*` wildcards. An empty or null list matches everything.

quarantined_by.description: Username of the user who quarantined the test

quarantined_from.description: Where the test was quarantined from

number.description: Number of the build or pipeline the test was quarantined from

slug.description: Slug of the build or pipeline the test was quarantined from

test_case_identifier.description: Identifier of the test case, when the test report provides one

test_suite_name.description: Names of the test suites containing the test case, outermost first

401.description: Unauthorized - no valid personal access token or workspace API token

404.description: Not found - app or quarantined test does not exist, or user is not authorized
